quotes.text: Hosting 90GB on Internet Archive is step one. Mirroring the torrents is step two, before copyright lawyers notice the auction bypass. Seed it while it exists.
quotes.author: soltanov
quotes.source: Hacker News — In the wake of Tippett Studios' closure, a digital archive appears online
quotes.extraction_note: Pragmatic, action-oriented advice with a great closing imperative. Very 'seed it before it's gone'.
